# UCAIug IEC 61968-9 3rd edition (CDV2) example messages

Unmodified copies of the 16 example messages in `UCA TF 14/Part 9/3rd-Edition (CDV2)/XMLs/`
of the UCAIug CIM Users Group "Standards Artifacts" download, the
examples of the figures that IEC 61968-9:2024 annex G points to.
`SHA256SUMS` lists each file; `TestUCAIugExamplesUnmodified` checks them.

Licence: Apache License, Version 2.0, Copyright 2022 UCAIug (as the
schemas of the same download state; see the module's NOTICE). They are
test vectors only and are not part of the package.

They are written in the 2011 namespaces, and some have defects of their
own (a prefix bound to another name, elements out of schema order, an
element renamed since, two fragments that are not well formed); the
tests say which, and what the package does with each.
